---
title: "Methods and data"
---

## Data sources

| Source | Used for | Latency |
|---|---|---|
| [City of Flagstaff / Coconino County ALERT network](https://rain.flagstaffaz.gov/jefmap/) | Rain totals and timing across 39 Flagstaff-area gauges | Minutes |
| [NRCS SNOTEL](https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/wps/portal/wcc/home/) (Fort Valley, Snowslide Canyon, Fry) | Snow water equivalent, snow depth, precipitation, temperature | Daily |
| NWS Flagstaff Pulliam Airport via [RCC-ACIS](https://www.rcc-acis.org/) | Monthly temperature and precipitation, 1991–2020 normals | About 1 day |
| [ERA5](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/) (Copernicus Climate Change Service) | Moisture transport, 250-hPa wind, 500-hPa height | About 5 days |
| [NHC best track](https://ftp.nhc.noaa.gov/atcf/btk/) | Tropical cyclone positions | Hours (operational; final after season) |

## Definitions

- **IVT (integrated vapour transport):** the magnitude of the vertically integrated water-vapour flux, in kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹, from ERA5's eastward and northward components.
- **Atmospheric-river conditions:** IVT ≥ 250 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹.
- **Network rain:** the median and the 10th–90th percentile range across city and county gauges, so that no single gauge stands in for the city.
- **Provisional / final:** event pages are provisional until ERA5 covers the event (about 5 days after it ends).
- **Event window:** a UTC period chosen to contain the event's rain; gauge totals are summed over it. Airport and SNOTEL values are for the local (MST) calendar days it covers.

## Event tags

Tags are assigned by rule, not by judgement:

| Tag | Rule |
|---|---|
| IVT ≥ 250 / IVT < 250 | Maximum ERA5 IVT at the grid point nearest Flagstaff during the event window |
| Tropical cyclone nearby | An NHC best-track position (tropical depression or stronger, or its remnant) within 1,500 km of Flagstaff between one day before and the end of the event window |
| Snow | Snowfall at the airport, or snow water equivalent above zero at a SNOTEL site at the end of the event |
| Provisional / Final | Whether ERA5 covers the event window |
